trigger: any applied section whose only change to a title is release or epoch
summary: diff_changes pairs a removed and an added row by identity stem (version blanked) and writes NO ledger row when the version strings are equal; epoch and release are not in identity_key but ARE in instance_key, so a release-only or epoch-only update (rpm/deb/pacman/apk release bump, flatpak commit with version='') is dropped from a non-regenerable history. Echoed by happy-path, compliance-officer C1, enterprise-readiness F4 (shown the finding).

trigger: manual DELETE of installed_software rows or a partial table restore leaving facet_state
summary: A software_facet_state row holding a hash with no installed_software rows is treated as a held facet: the next full diffs against an empty old set so every row becomes a phantom install ledger row and counter increment. Trigger is an out-of-band DB mutation (outside the Deployment contract, whole-database restore of this build's backup is consistent). FLAGGED: derived HIGH by table; a non-author adjudicator must rule if it is to be de-escalated. Cheap fix: compare section_hash_of_normalised(old_rows) with prior->section_hash.

trigger: replica clock >=400 d behind (e.g. RTC at 1970)
summary: A replica whose clock is >=400 days behind stamps observed_at older than the Postgres cutoff; other replicas' rows keep has_survivor true so the would-wipe decline never fires and the capped drain deletes the history. COVERED by the binding gate-1 ruling F2 (observed_at = replica clock, documented); recorded as a consequence, not re-raised as new. FLAGGED for the caller.

trigger: enrolled/compromised agent flapping two disjoint 20k-row fulls
summary: software_changes growth by one enrolled agent is bounded by no per-call or per-agent ledger cap and ReportInventory has no rate limit (agent_service_impl.cpp:1010-1062); alternating 20k-row fulls write up to ~40k ledger rows per call, all inside the 400-day window so the prune cannot reclaim them. Independent derivations (security-guardian, architect A1, sre SRE-2) all I5/E3 MEDIUM; I5(a)/(b) judged not met.

Data-retention register row for software_inventory_store says current-state only / no time-based reaper and lists only inventory_state, installed_software; ADR-0016:163-164 says no history in central PG. Both false after this change (400-day per-device history, clock-guarded prune). Doc-update obligation via the ADR-0016 routed row (item 6).

trigger: component table CHECK(false) after an applied apps delta
summary: No test that a SQL fault in a LATER section rolls back an earlier applied section, its ledger rows and the counter.

No lexical wiring test pins the hourly prune tick (precedent: test_presence_departure_wiring_lexical.py for #5678); deleting or mis-gating the block leaves every test green. Existing gate re-run by orchestrator: OK (3 tests).
No test has agent A (or another facet) name agent B's / another facet's row hash in a delta; the agent_id AND source scoping clauses of the - DELETE are untested.

trigger: comp section with >=2 same-kind empty-path records
summary: Two component records of the same kind with an empty path (parser rejects only empty kind/name) collide on path_hash and the section is answered mismatch for a FULL section too: re-nacked every cycle, nothing stored. Docs/alert say 'self-heals' and blame the delta writer (enterprise F3).

trigger: device with >=20,000 components or rows in one facet
summary: A facet or component set that reaches the 20,000 cap has no way to be stored: a full is refused row_cap, a delta past the cap is mismatch; the agent resends full forever; docs claim self-heal.

trigger: 31 s statement timeout or 11 s advisory-lock hold
summary: Any SQL fault (statement_timeout, lock_timeout, connection reset) in one section aborts the whole call and nacks every non-refused section need_full; agents resend all facets in full while the DB is already slow.

trigger: part-6 Decline that never settles; slow drain
summary: No signal for prune health: declines, errors (warn log only), rows pruned, ledger size or growth rate. Shared repo gap (#4095 in pg_retention_guard.cpp:278-282) but a new 400-day append table inherits it.
No operator trim/recovery documentation for a huge ledger (delete_agent is the only reclaim; symptoms and the two knobs unstated).

trigger: v3 agent sending a per-user path
summary: software_changes.identity_key embeds the lower-cased install_location and is persisted for 400 days after the installed_software row is hard-deleted; column is redundant (instance_key/name/publisher/version stored). ADR-0016 s8 slot-13 outcome does not mention the ledger copy. Server does not violate the sender rule (writer duty).

Two up-to-12-pass prune drains (offline_endpoint and the new one) fire on tick 1 and every 60 ticks: preflight_runner_thread_ stalls up to 12x30 s and stop() waits one statement timeout. Orchestrator: I8 (bounded stall), architect LOW, sre MEDIUM; kept LOW.

trigger: stem with >=2 instances where one churns
summary: Pairing within a stem follows instance_key hash order, not version: one equal-version churn plus a real version change in one stem can yield two upgrades instead of one.
Comment says a full is a baseline only when the facet is not held at all or was last disabled; code also baselines on an empty held hash (status-only first section). 123 columns.
'location churn -> NO row' comments overstate (only normalised-equal location); '13 params' should be 12.
mismatch cause lists in metrics.md, the alert annotation, inventory.md and ADR omit a facet left over the per-call cap and a repeated component path.
Annotation says a non-verifying delta is counted separately; mismatch also raises the report-level need_full ratio.
'A server whose clock has jumped declines the first pass' is wrong (first pass over existing rows always declines and records its anchor); '50,000 per hourly pass' hides the 12-pass drain.

CPU work (diff_changes, normalize, section-hash recompute) and component hashing run inside the transaction holding a pooled connection and the per-agent lock, contradicting the 'prepared OUTSIDE the transaction' principle.
v2 full replace drops software_facet_state but leaves software_components (and software_changes) rows for the agent.

Register sentence that the 2M-endpoint target 'exceeds' capacity and 'needs a 5-minute cadence' is wrong (12x50k/h = 14.4M rows/day/replica); changelog 'Every stored section writes an entry' overstates (components write none).

trigger: delta with >100 - hashes or a generic plan
summary: DELETE ... instance_key = ANY(array) may not use the partial index installed_software_instance_idx (WHERE instance_key <> ''); adding AND instance_key <> '' is result-neutral. Probe: EXPLAIN on a disposable PG.
Post-apply verify re-reads the whole facet and the per-call cap does not bound it: 8 facets x 20k rows in one tiny call ~180k rows read in-txn.
SAVEPOINT/RELEASE round trips on full installed_software sections that cannot mismatch.
Unpartitioned ~800M-row ledger at 2M-endpoint target; autovacuum default scale factor leaves a left-edge dead-entry pile on the observed_at index; PK change_id index unread.

trigger: two concurrent calls of one agent
summary: ts = now_secs() is taken before the advisory-lock wait (up to 10 s): observed_at/last_seen can carry pre-wait time and (observed_at, change_id) order can invert vs apply order.
delete_agent failure under a held ingest lock is logged at debug only; mitigated: AgentDecommission records a per-store Failed status in the audited route result (compliance-officer).

Status-only over a held facet (collector timeout) drops it from the report hash and breaks the delta chain: next delta need_full, full replace; fleet-wide slow-collector event becomes a full-replace storm. UP-3 replayed delta -> need_full also converges. UP-4 writer hash-parity loop never self-heals and only HighNeedFullRatio sees it.

Forward-skewed replica (>1 d ahead) stamps rows excluded from the guard denominator and not prunable until real time catches up (skew + 400 d); no alert. Refined by chaos-injector: bounded by the skew, not unbounded, so I8.

Wire-contract gaps for the SAM-15 writer: component size/mtime canonical decimal ('007' parses to 7, '-1' to 0), field-wise std::tie sort vs serialized order, empty-set hash (SHA-256 of empty string).

Test gaps: alert test does not pin for: 1h; boundary exactly kV3MaxRows/Components; component same-path new-hash delta; non-canonical size/mtime; seam end-to-end for mismatch; weak ledger from/to_version assertions; same-second observed_at.
Stale after job count 49->50 and fifth clock-guard adopter.

summary: POLICY-FLOOR CANDIDATE, provenance pre-existing (identical on base 1d3bc3ea9, text from v7/v8): ladder row says 'Deploy the server before agents that emit the new fields', 'a rolling upgrade is not supported...', 'a rollback to an older binary only is clean'. REFUTED by chaos-injector (Gate 5): any_write is true only for a status-only, full-rows or non-colliding full-component section; the only full path that can return kMismatch is a component full via 23505, which needs equal (kind, sha256(path)), already caught by the prepass on (kind,path) bytes and excluded from any_write; a delta cannot run on a non-v3 agent; NUL/invalid UTF-8 is kFail with full rollback. Residual: add the coupling unit test (tracked as NICE).
